text:
emma: follow-up from the 00:45 UTC throughput incident. need to lock owners for remediation, SLO handling, and a short retro on why this kept recurring. summary: p99 tail spike during deployment window + autoscaler lag = throughput collapse.
raj: numbers?
emma: p95 ~180ms stable, p99 spiked to 2.2s for ~18m (00:42-01:00 UTC). throughput dropped from ~90rps to ~12rps. error-budget burn for rolling-week now ~19%.
oliver: pattern repeated 3x in last month, always around config-rollover + backup window overlap.
infra-bot: incident-3412300000 created: https://incidents.redwood/3412300000  severity P2, linked to throughput-regressions.
emma: remediation proposal (concise): 1) implement transient SLO alert window for 00:30-01:15 UTC (alerting tolerance only, not permanent SLO change) 2) route-level graceful degradation to lite-model on tail-latency triggers 3) pre-warm hook + standby-reservoir for model pools during rollout windows 4) dashboard + error-budget projection + per-customer SLA headroom panel 5) longer-term autoscaler cooldown tuning.
raj: prefer route-level graceful degradation + pre-warm; avoid touching global SLO numbers. product/CS signoff?
cs-sam: if we only change alerting and use route-level fallback, we can largely avoid SLA amendments. CS wants a threshold for when customers are notified (suggest >45m cumulative impact).
tia: assignments and deadlines: Raj - dashboard + error-budget projection + customer headroom widget by Thu EOD; Oliver - pre-warm + standby-reservoir PR and staging canary by next Mon; Tia - fallback route prototype + canary by Tue; Emma - runbook + exec brief + customer-notice template by Fri.
raj: dashboard draft (PromQL) I'll add:
```
# p99 by instance warm state and fallback flag for /v1/respond
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(request_latency_seconds_bucket{route="/v1/respond"}[5m])) by (le, instance_warm, route_fallback))
```
raj: also adding an error-budget projection widget: days-to-zero = current_error_budget / (burn_rate * 24h). will make a table of top 10 customers by SLA headroom.
oliver: pre-warm plan: add pre-warm hook to pool-manager, keep 3 standby_reservoir instances per region during rollout windows. will open PR today; staging canary scheduled Tue 00:30, prod Fri 00:30. will include cost delta estimate.
tia: fallback route plan: when p99>1.0s for 3m, mark route_fallback=true and shift 25% traffic to lite-variant; page only if route_fallback=true AND error_budget_burn > 5%/day. will add regression tests.
infra-bot: action items added to incident checklist: Raj(dashboard), Oliver(pre-warm), Tia(fallback), Emma(runbook). Deadlines recorded.
emma: decision check: do we agree to keep SLOs unchanged, implement alerting tolerance + fallback + standby-reservoir, and notify customers if fallback affects them >45m? react with :thumbsup: to approve.
raj: :thumbsup:
oliver: :thumbsup:
tia: :thumbsup:
cs-sam: :thumbsup:
emma: ok moving forward. small follow-ups: - Raj add pager suppression rule: only page when p99>1.0s AND queue_depth>threshold. - Oliver include cost estimate in PR. - Tia add CI regression to avoid flapping fallback.
raj: noted, will add suppression rule and the customer headroom table.
oliver: will include cost numbers and schedule flag in PR for trial during rollout windows only.
tia: regression tests will be part of perf CI and block merges if flappy.
emma: i'll post the exec one-pager this afternoon and attach the customer message template. if anything blocks owners flag here and we'll escalate. :eyes:
